idea.name: StudyNest
idea.description: A verified housing marketplace for international students in Italian university cities. Landlords pay a monthly listing subscription and get pre-screened student tenants; students get verified listings, video viewings and contracts in English.
idea.target_customer: Small landlords renting rooms to university students

idea.name: ShiftPilot
idea.description: AI staff scheduling for independent restaurants and bars. It forecasts covers from bookings, weather and local events, then builds rotas that respect contracts and labour rules, cutting overstaffing and last-minute gaps.
idea.target_customer: Independent restaurants and bars with 5-40 staff

idea.name: GreenFleet
idea.description: Charging and energy-cost optimisation software for logistics SMEs moving their van fleets to electric. It schedules charging around routes and electricity prices and reports the cost per delivery against diesel.
